techniques.name: Strategic cognitive offloading
techniques.goal: Reduce internal memory burden by externalizing information/intended actions when benefit exceeds cost
techniques.mechanism: Use lists, reminders, notes, external state and automation selectively based on memory load, distraction likelihood and consequence.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Personal Executive should offload fragile commitments but not turn every thought into an alert.
avoid_when: When unaided learning/recall is itself the goal
Trivial habits where reminder overhead exceeds value

techniques.name: Cost-benefit reminder decision
techniques.goal: Use reminders when expected forgetting cost exceeds reminder-setting/interruption cost
techniques.mechanism: Estimate consequence, memory load, distraction, recurrence, reminder friction and reliability before creating/surfacing a reminder.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Maps naturally to proactivity expected-utility engine.
avoid_when: Routine actions with near-certain spontaneous completion
risks: Model estimates of forgetting may be poorly calibrated

techniques.name: Low-friction reminder capture
techniques.goal: Make externalization cheap enough that important intentions are not lost
techniques.mechanism: Minimize steps/typing to capture a future intention; infer context/time/project but preserve easy correction.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Fast capture first; organization/dedupe can happen later.
avoid_when: Inference would make consequential scheduling silently wrong
risks: Low friction can increase junk/duplicate reminders

techniques.name: Reminder reliability awareness
techniques.goal: Avoid cognitive dependence on an external system that may silently fail
techniques.mechanism: Track whether reminder channel/device/scheduler is healthy; for critical commitments use deterministic delivery verification/redundancy and surface degraded state.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Critical offloaded intentions must not have a single silent failure point.

techniques.name: Graceful degradation of external memory
techniques.goal: Protect users when Agent OS/reminder infrastructure is unavailable
techniques.mechanism: Maintain exportable/current task lists, visible critical commitments and recovery paths so externalized state remains accessible outside the primary agent path.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Run periodic low-risk recovery drills; critical state never exists only in a transient model context.

techniques.name: Metacognitive prediction + feedback for offloading calibration
techniques.goal: Improve decisions about when external support is actually useful
techniques.mechanism: Have user/system predict likely recall/task success, then compare with outcomes and update reminder/offloading policy; feedback matters more than prediction alone in the cited 2026 experiments.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS can infer predicted probability internally and learn from completion; explicit user calibration exercises optional.
avoid_when: User should not be burdened with explicit prediction questions routinely

techniques.name: Implementation intentions / if-then plans
techniques.goal: Improve prospective goal execution by binding a concrete cue to an action
techniques.mechanism: Represent intention as 'when/if cue X occurs, do Y' rather than only a vague goal.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Translate natural commitments into explicit triggers when appropriate; keep original goal alongside trigger.
risks: monitoring can have small ongoing-task cost

techniques.name: Event-based over clock-based trigger when natural cue exists
techniques.goal: Surface an intention at the moment it becomes actionable
techniques.mechanism: Bind reminders/workflows to meaningful event/context change instead of arbitrary time if the event can be detected reliably.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Pair critical event triggers with deadline/backstop time when needed.

techniques.name: Deadline backstop for event-triggered intention
techniques.goal: Prevent an event-triggered task from disappearing if the expected cue never occurs
techniques.mechanism: Schedule a latest-action/review deadline in addition to event watch.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Dependency resolution automatically cancels/updates backstop.
risks: Extra reminders if dependency resolves but state is not reconciled

techniques.name: Pre-interruption task-state capture
techniques.goal: Reduce resumption cost after switching away
techniques.mechanism: Before planned interruption/context switch, capture current goal, exact next step, open artifacts, blockers and unresolved decisions.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS automatically creates a tiny handoff on inactivity/project switch/explicit pause.
risks: Capture friction can itself discourage switching

techniques.name: Salient resumption cue
techniques.goal: Reactivate suspended task goal quickly
techniques.mechanism: Show a clear cue tied to last meaningful action/next action—not a generic project title—when work resumes.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prominent 'You were here / next: X' with evidence timestamp.

techniques.name: Chronological activity replay for resumption
techniques.goal: Restore local context after interruption without rereading everything
techniques.mechanism: Present recent meaningful actions in order, emphasizing changed artifacts and decisions near the interruption.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Summarize significant events, then allow drill-down to raw timeline.
risks: Too much chronology recreates context overload

techniques.name: Prospective goal encoding before planned switch
techniques.goal: Make future resumption easier by explicitly stating what to do next before leaving
techniques.mechanism: At pause/switch encode a next-action intention and optionally expected trigger for resumption.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Agent OS asks no question if next action can be inferred from run state; records it automatically.
risks: Can become stale if others change state while away

techniques.name: Automatic crash/interruption handoff reconstruction
techniques.goal: Recover when no pre-interruption note could be made
techniques.mechanism: Use recent telemetry, files changed, tool calls, checkpoints and unfinished plans to reconstruct last stable state and likely next action with uncertainty.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Distinguish observed last action from inferred next action.
risks: Inference can invent a next step

techniques.name: Interruption suppression during high-focus state
techniques.goal: Reduce cognitive switching cost and stress
techniques.mechanism: Delay nonurgent notifications while the user/system is in active focused work; batch for boundary or digest.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use task-boundary/interaction signals; immediate alerts require urgency threshold.

techniques.name: Task-boundary interruption preference
techniques.goal: Deliver nonurgent help at lower-cost moments
techniques.mechanism: Prefer natural boundaries—after save/commit/task completion/meeting end—over middle of an active subtask.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Proactivity engine includes 'wait until boundary' action.

techniques.name: Measure human effort, not just completion time
techniques.goal: Prevent optimizations that make users faster by forcing more stress/effort
techniques.mechanism: Include corrections, interruptions, context switches, clicks, re-reading, frustration proxies and subjective effort when evaluating workflows.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: A faster workflow that raises correction/stress cost is not automatically better.

techniques.name: Project-centric information views
techniques.goal: Reduce fragmentation across files/messages/notes/apps by organizing around the activity the information serves
techniques.mechanism: Resolve items to stable project/domain entities and provide a project view linking canonical artifacts rather than copying them into app silos.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: One canonical identity + multiple human-friendly views, consistent with existing metadata-driven project architecture.
avoid_when: Item genuinely belongs to no project/domain

techniques.name: Capture-first, organize-later inbox
techniques.goal: Avoid losing information because classification is too costly at capture time
techniques.mechanism: Accept low-friction capture into durable staging, then asynchronously dedupe/classify/link/review.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Existing browser bridge durable inbox is the right architectural pattern.
avoid_when: Consequential record must be classified before action

techniques.name: Refinding-first design
techniques.goal: Optimize stored information for future reuse, not merely successful capture
techniques.mechanism: Store stable source identity, why-it-mattered/context, project/entity links, date, provenance and searchable text/features so future retrieval can reconstruct intent.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Every capture should preserve the minimum clues future-you/model needs to understand why it was kept.

techniques.name: Avoid duplicate filing through reference/link views
techniques.goal: Prevent multiple copies becoming conflicting sources of truth
techniques.mechanism: Keep one canonical object and expose it through tags/projects/people/views/links instead of copying content into several folders/stores.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Matches user's stable-ID/metadata-driven repository design.
avoid_when: Privacy boundary requires physically separate copy with explicit derivation
risks: Canonical object may become unavailable to some domains

techniques.name: Automatic resurfacing by context
techniques.goal: Reduce reliance on remembering that stored information exists
techniques.mechanism: When project/person/place/task becomes active, retrieve a small ranked set of relevant prior items and unfinished commitments.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Prefer quiet side panel/packet over interruption unless actionable/urgent.
avoid_when: Context signal weak; resurfacing would distract

techniques.name: Forget support intentionally for low-stakes automation training
techniques.goal: Avoid total dependence on external memory for abilities the user wants to retain
techniques.mechanism: For chosen domains, occasionally encourage unaided recall or keep reminders as backup rather than primary cue, because expected reliable reminders can reduce internal maintenance/encoding.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Off by default for obligations; opt-in for learning/skill retention.
use_when: Knowledge user explicitly wants to remember
avoid_when: Bills/deadlines/critical obligations where forgetting has real cost

techniques.name: Critical-intention redundancy
techniques.goal: Prevent one memory/reminder failure from causing high-consequence miss
techniques.mechanism: Use at least two independent cues/channels or an escalation chain for rare high-impact commitments.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Risk-based only; track common-cause dependence between channels.

techniques.name: Reminder completion reconciliation
techniques.goal: Stop reminders once the underlying obligation is actually resolved
techniques.mechanism: Link reminder/task to observable completion evidence from calendar/email/file/workflow/user action and cancel/suppress future alerts.
techniques.agent_os_pattern: Use explicit/evidenced completion; uncertain completion prompts candidate/review rather than cancellation.
risks: False completion inference can silence needed reminder
